language.reason: Preserve existing product screen language. This is no localization change.

purpose: Before each permission request, explain the data/purpose, required combination, optional Orders choice, Cancel behavior and return path without implying grants, asset readiness or app approval.

common.cancel_explanation: Cancel closes this explanation without starting a permission request.
common.reconnect_context: Review the access for this connection. Cancel leaves the current setup unchanged.

modals.heading: Connect Shopify products
paragraphs: Allow AdsTable to read your products and variants to match product reporting to your Shopify catalog.
Product access is required to finish product setup. Order access is optional and will be requested separately when you choose an order-based feature.
modals.review_summary_tr: Ürün ve varyant okuma temel ürün kurulumu için gerekli; sipariş erişimi bu isteme eklenmez.
modals.entry: First in-app product setup on existing Settings; an existing Home setup notice may navigate to Settings, never start authorization automatically.
modals.connect_backend: runtime.permissionSetup.requestProducts({verified, action: connect}); fixed authenticated server action, closed unless separate request/release gates pass
modals.missing_copy: Product access is still missing. Resume setup when you are ready.

modals.heading: Connect Shopify orders
paragraphs: Allow AdsTable to read recent orders and purchased products to compare Shopify sales with marketing attribution.
Order access is optional. Cancelling does not change your existing product connection.
Order access helps investigate attribution overlap; it does not, by itself, confirm duplicate attribution for individual orders.
modals.review_summary_tr: Son siparişler ve satın alınan ürünlerle atıf karşılaştırması; isteğe bağlı, Products izni korunur, kesin çift sayım vaat edilmez.
modals.entry: Explicit order-feature Connect within existing surfaces. Final Overlap report button placement remains the reporting UI decision; not inserted by this design.
modals.connect_backend: runtime.permissionSetup.requestOrders({verified, action: connect}); requires already observed Products and separate release/request gates
modals.return_backend: runtime.permissionSetup.afterReturn({verified}); inspect current grant and keep base independent
modals.missing_copy: Order access is not connected. Your product connection is unchanged.

modals.heading: Connect Google Ads and Merchant Center
paragraphs: Allow AdsTable to read your advertising data and catalog to match product reporting.
Both Google Ads and Merchant Center access are needed to finish this connection. You need an accessible Merchant Center account, including for Search-only setups.
Google permissions may also allow changes. AdsTable uses this connection to read data and does not edit your campaigns or catalog.
modals.review_summary_tr: Ads ve Merchant birlikte gerekli. Merchant olmadan kurulum eksik kalır. Google izninin genişliği ile AdsTable’ın okuma amacı ayrı anlatılır.
modals.entry: Google Connect/reconnect or user-selected permission resume in existing Settings
modals.connect_backend: runtime.beginCombinedSetup({installationAuthority}); identity_v1 fixed on server, never existing reporting_v1 begin by accident
modals.return_backend: combined setup account/reporting selection then native Merchant verification; none alone completes setup
modals.missing_copy: Google Ads or Merchant Center access is still missing. Resume setup to review the connection.

modals.heading: Connect Meta ads and catalog
paragraphs: Allow AdsTable to read advertising data and the catalog available to your selected business.
Both ad account and catalog access are needed to finish setup. You may also see business and Page permissions.
Some business and catalog permissions also allow changes. AdsTable uses this connection for reporting and product matching; it does not edit those assets.
modals.review_summary_tr: Reklam hesabı ve katalog birlikte gerekli; işletme/Sayfa izinleri de görünür. Yönetim izinlerinin genişliği gizlenmez, ürün/satış ayrımı vaat edilmez.
modals.entry: Meta Connect/reconnect or user-selected permission resume in existing Settings
modals.connect_backend: runtime.beginCombinedSetup({installationAuthority}); existing identity_v1 scope set only, native app/dependency readiness separate
modals.return_backend: combined account selection and native token/user/business/catalog access proof; no Ad/catalog delivery claim
modals.missing_copy: Ad account or catalog access is still missing. Resume setup to review the connection.

modals.heading: Connect Klaviyo
paragraphs: Allow AdsTable to read account details and campaign, flow, metric and event data for reporting.
After connecting, add your estimated monthly Klaviyo cost to finish setup. Enter 0 if you have no monthly cost.
The cost is entered separately in AdsTable. If you leave it incomplete, use Resume setup to finish it later.
modals.review_summary_tr: Mevcut beş okuma izni; aylık tahmin ayrı adım, sıfır geçerli. Maliyet eksikliği yeniden OAuth istemez.
modals.entry: Klaviyo Connect/reconnect or permission resume in existing Settings
modals.connect_backend: Existing Klaviyo authorization entry with exact existing five read scopes; no new provider profile
modals.return_backend: Existing account verification then Estimated Monthly Cost stage; missing cost resumes cost stage, not OAuth
modals.missing_copy: Finish the remaining Klaviyo setup step with Resume setup.

flow.before_connect: Only one explanation open; Cancel, close control and Escape in this stage close it with no new native request. Opening the explanation has no provider/token/config mutation.
flow.on_connect: Synchronous in-flight guard captures provider/feature, closes the explanation with reason connect, then issues one authenticated server action. Never infer Cancel from the hide event caused by Connect.
flow.pending: Explanation is closed, provider section shows Starting connection… and prevents a second Connect. Closing a pending display is not a claim that a started provider request was undone.
flow.native_consent: Shopify/provider controls their permission screen. No automated native screen interaction, no custom Shopify-look permission prompt.
flow.on_return: Read current server/native evidence; route by stage. No mount effect or return field automatically restarts OAuth.
flow.connected: Only final authorized server setup readiness can show overall Connected. Current prepared access/scope helpers authorizesActivation=false cannot produce it.
flow.legacy: Existing reporting_v1 remains separate until explicitly wired. A new incomplete combined setup must not delete/revoke the current reporting connection or claim it has been upgraded.

resume_routing.action: Open same explanation; native request only after a new Connect.
Open verified account selection; no OAuth restart.
Open reporting account selection; no OAuth restart.
Select/verify current Merchant or business/catalog targets using trusted server authority; do not request permissions again just because selection is missing.
Show access verified / activation pending; no Connected or automatic grant. App approval and UI/release acceptance are separate.
Open existing estimated monthly cost step; accept zero, distinguish missing; no OAuth restart.

desktop_mobile.information_architecture: Same title/body/actions at desktop and mobile; native component sizing and scroll only.
checks: Read all paragraphs without horizontal scrolling or truncation
Footer actions reachable with keyboard and touch
Native close/Escape before Connect starts no request
Focus enters modal and returns to exact trigger on idle Cancel/close
Only one modal visible, no nested explanation+account/consent modal stack
Connect closes explanation intentionally; hide callback does not cancel confirmed intent
Real Shopify Admin desktop and actual mobile evidence required, not static preview
